target_applications: retail greeting/guidance, museum/airport information, hospitality, eldercare assistance, fetch-and-carry

height_mm.source: https://robotsguide.com/robots/careobot (158 cm full config per originofbots)

dof_total.source: https://robotsguide.com/robots/careobot (base 2, arms 2x7, grippers 2x2, torso ball joint 2, sensor ring 1)

torso_lift.value: no lift column; 2-DoF spherical torso joint, 360-deg rotation

battery_kwh.source: 40 Ah li-ion pack, voltage not stated

actuators.value: base: 6 Wittenstein motors; arms: Schunk PowerBall modules (PRL100, ERB145, ERB115); spherical joints: 2x Maxon each

end_effector.value: 2-DoF gripper (one-finger style) with integrated sensors; swappable for tray

sensors_base.value: 3 safety laser scanners with safety PLC; torso 3x 2.5D sensors; sensor ring w/ SICK Visionary-T, Intel RealSense

software_stack.value: Ubuntu Linux, ROS (open cob_* packages), Python control app

safety_compliance.value: safety laser scanners + safety PLC on base; no public ISO 13482 cert

availability.value: no longer sold; product line dropped after Mojin renamed 4am Robotics (Apr 2023, AMR pivot)

deployment_evidence.value: 'Paul' greeter at Saturn stores from Oct 2016 (Ingolstadt first); museum/airport/care trials; small install base, no new deployments since ~2020

notes: KEY STATUS FINDING: Mojin Robotics GmbH was renamed 4am Robotics GmbH on 2023-04-13 (Schiller/SCIO group) and now sells only AMRs — Care-O-bot 4 is commercially discontinued, contradicting 'still active' assumption. Platform remains a Fraunhofer IPA research asset.
